verdict.rationale: Gemini's first-party docs describe Notebooks as a way to "organize your projects in a dedicated, focused space" with a "continuous chat experience that remembers your sources, instructions, and ongoing discussions." That covers the story's project space with shared files, instructions and conversation context. Custom Gems separately support reusable instructions. Missing for 10: detail on grouping multiple separate chats under one notebook, specifics of file/source handling and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Gemini Notebooks.
